attchmntText: Bohra Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bohra Industries Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss of 71.58 lakhs for the quarter and 128.13 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations was nil. The Board appointed Mr. Sanjay Rastogi, DIN 01100960, as Additional Non-executive Independent Director, subject to shareholder approval, for five years from November 13, 2026. Mrs. Nirmal Kaur, DIN 09066852, was appointed as Additional Non-executive Director. The Audit Committee was reconstituted with Mr. Sanjay Rastogi as Chairperson. The Stakeholders Relationship Committee was reconstituted with Mrs. Nirmal Kaur as Chairperson. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee was reconstituted with Mr. Ankaj Kumar Mishra as Chairperson.
